title: Descriptive power and predictive limits of a discrete Hasimoto--DNLS model of protein backbone structure
summary: Determining 3D protein structure from sequence remains a fundamental biophysical challenge. The C$_α$ backbone's discrete Frenet geometry maps, via a Hasimoto transform, to a complex scalar field $ψ=κ\,e^{i\sumτ}$ obeying a discrete nonlinear Schrödinger equation (DNLS), whose solitons reproduce secondary-structure motifs. Whether this compact mapping extends to a predictive folding framework remains open.
